sections.text:
- PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers severity=warning Prometheus prometheus/prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 is not connected to any Alertmanagers.
- KubeSchedulerDown severity=critical KubeScheduler has disappeared from Prometheus target discovery.
- CPUThrottlingHigh severity=info 96.7% throttling of CPU in namespace otel-demo for container recommendation in pod recommendation-5f45f75855-htttv on cluster .
- RequestLatency severity=warning Latency in service frontend-proxy in namespace otel-demo is above 1500ms (current: 2498.749999999996s)
- RequestLatency severity=warning Latency in service frontend in namespace otel-demo is above 1500ms (current: 2024.999999999995s)
- RequestErrorRate severity=warning Request error rate in service frontend-proxy in namespace otel-demo is above 0 (current: 0.016666666666666666)
- Watchdog severity=none This is an alert meant to ensure that the entire alerting pipeline is functional.
This alert is always firing, therefore it should always be firing in Alertmanager
and always fire against a receiver. There are integrations with various notification
mechanisms that send a notification when this alert is not firing. For example the
"DeadMansSnitch" integration in PagerDuty.

- KubeControllerManagerDown severity=critical KubeControllerManager has disappeared from Prometheus target discovery.

parsed.root_cause: CPU 壓力測試實驗導致推薦服務容器 CPU 被嚴重限制，進而引發叢集控制平面組件（KubeScheduler、KubeControllerManager）因資源飢餓而無響應。
evidence: 告警顯示 recommendation 容器 CPU 限流率高達 96.7%
KubeScheduler 和 KubeControllerManager 同時從 Prometheus 目標中消失，表明控制平面因資源競爭而癱瘓
事件日誌確認 chaos-mesh 的 StressChaos 實驗正在對 recommendation 命名空間執行 CPU 壓力測試
